newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen falling in profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen falling in profit-taking.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to fall in profit-taking after three consecutive gains, on the back of Tuesday's strong selling after price fixing and falls of most stocks in the continuous trade, analysts said.
But they said any falls should not be significant and the market was likely to maintain its seven-week horizontal trend.
Polish power equipment repairer Zaklady Remontowe Energetyki Warszawa SA (ZREW) starts bourse trade on the parallel market on Wednesday.
